'''Xantar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Xantar system/Legends|Xantar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. 

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
It included green forests, and was the homeworld of a [[Unidentified Xantar species|gray-skinned sentient species]]. Luke Skywalker visited the world as the guest of a native [[Bug-Eyes|pilot]], and met another human visitor, [[Indiana Jones]].<ref name="Yoda Stories" />
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
The appearance of the alien and Luke Skywalker's trip to this planet at the end of ''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]'' is a reference to the end of an earlier game of similar design, ''Indiana Jones and his Desktop Adventures''. At the end of that game, Indiana Jones is visited by the alien and taken onboard his [[Unidentified Xantar starship|starship]].
